newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine police catch suspected hit-squad member.
newsitem.headline: Philippine police catch suspected hit-squad member.

text.p: Philippine police said on Friday they arrested a suspected leader of a communist hit squad accused of attacks on police officers and businessmen it considers corrupt.

A police statement said Arnold Salazar was arrested in a commercial district in the Manila suburb of Quezon City during a drug bust. He had initially been followed on suspicion of being a drug dealer, it said.
Police recovered a pistol and subversive documents from Salazar, the statement said.
Authorities said they believe Salazar is a senior officer of the Alex Boncayao Brigade, which has been accused in a string of attacks on businessmen and police officers.
Salazar is a suspect in a pair of killings, including that of a police colonel in 1990.
